'''Druuven Herr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. A strong supporter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], he was known to be slow-witted in conversation.
